title: Velvety Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A tangy and silky one-pot Slovakian dish featuring sultanas, this stew is perfect for a cold winter night, and is sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Heat a bamboo steamer over medium heat with a little bit of oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the pork shoulder pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the sultanas, pork broth, apple cider vinegar, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the steamer.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Use a little bit of the liquid to deglaze the fond from the bottom of the steamer.
Continue to simmer the stew for another 30 minutes, or until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme.
